// TS §12.5: "the no-double-booking test races 5 reservations from separate processes with their own connections,
// which exercises the transaction and index (concurrent HTTP calls into one synchronous connection would pass
// without them)." This is that test: a real file-backed database, 5 real OS processes, no mocked concurrency.
import { execFile } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { insertItem } from "../src/features/loans/items.repository.ts";
import { openDb } from "../src/platform/db.ts";
import { migrate } from "../src/platform/migrate.ts";
import { insertUser } from "../src/platform/users.repository.ts";

const dirs: string[] = [];
afterEach(() => { for (const d of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); });

function worker(script: string, dbPath: string, dir: string, userId: string) {
  let resolve!: (r: { stdout: string; stderr: string; error: Error | null }) => void;
  const finished = new Promise<{ stdout: string; stderr: string; error: Error | null }>((r) => { resolve = r; });
  const child = execFile(
    process.execPath, ["--import", "tsx/esm", script, dbPath, "race-item", userId, dir],
    { timeout: 20_000, killSignal: "SIGKILL" },
    (error, stdout, stderr) => resolve({ stdout, stderr, error }),
  );
  return { child, finished };
}

describe("the one-active-loan-per-item invariant under real concurrency", () => {
  it("runs 5 ready reservation processes in transactions and lets exactly one win", async () => {
    const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "starter-race-")); dirs.push(dir);
    const dbPath = join(dir, "app.db");
    const db = openDb(dbPath);
    const workers: ReturnType<typeof worker>[] = [];
    try {
      migrate(db);
      insertItem(db, { id: "race-item", name: "Contested Microscope", created_at: 0 });
      const users = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => `user${n}`);
      for (const user of users) insertUser(db, { id: user, email: `${user}@example.test`, role: "member", password_hash: "x", created_at: 0 });

      const script = join(import.meta.dirname, "fixtures/concurrent-reserve-worker.ts");
      for (const user of users) workers.push(worker(script, dbPath, dir, user));
      const deadline = Date.now() + 15_000;
      while (!users.every((user) => existsSync(join(dir, `ready-${user}`)))) {
        const stopped = workers.find(({ child }) => child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null);
        if (stopped) {
          const result = await stopped.finished;
          throw new Error(`worker exited before the start barrier: ${result.stderr || result.stdout || result.error?.message}`);
        }
        if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error("workers did not reach the start barrier");
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
      }

      const before = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM loans").get() as { n: number };
      expect(before.n).toBe(0);
      writeFileSync(join(dir, "start"), "");
      const results = await Promise.all(workers.map(({ finished }) => finished));
      expect(results.map(({ error }) => error?.message ?? null)).toEqual([null, null, null, null, null]);
      expect(results.every(({ stdout }) => stdout === "ok" || stdout === "conflict"), JSON.stringify(results)).toBe(true);
      expect(results.filter(({ stdout }) => stdout === "ok")).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(results.filter(({ stdout }) => stdout === "conflict")).toHaveLength(4);

      const active = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM loans WHERE item_id = 'race-item' AND status = 'active'").get() as { n: number };
      expect(active.n).toBe(1);
      expect(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM loans").get()).toEqual({ n: 1 });
      expect(db.pragma("foreign_key_check")).toEqual([]);
    } finally {
      for (const { child } of workers) {
        if (child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) child.kill("SIGKILL");
      }
      await Promise.all(workers.map(({ finished }) => finished));
      db.close();
    }
  }, 25_000);
});
